_comment: EXT-63, arm 19 — the 1 h SETTLED-WINDOW validation of arm 18 (canonical single-layer
EXT-CB posture + LV-1 + LV-2).  The counterpart of arm 13, one window, two knobs.
RUN ONLY IF THE ARM-18 SMOKE MATCHES ITS PREDICTION (staged cadence).
WHAT ONLY 1 h CAN SHOW.  Arm 13 (the canonical posture at 1 h) is the reference:
ignition 24.7, trough 7.1, recovery to 22.4 by 30 min, a SECOND breath down to 10.1 at
~45 min, ending 20.95 rising; gate 0/0/0; in-band 121/121; deg-1 peak 31; rx-CB carry
fold fraction stuck at 43 %.  The BREATHING (+/-6 TECU on a ~20-30 min cycle) is the
open mechanism LV-2 exists to damp, and it is invisible at 20 epochs.
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN:
- Fold fraction rises materially above 43 % (the direct LV-1+LV-2 effect on the
prefit inject gate); skip rate near zero.
- Breathing amplitude damps vs arm 13: the second trough should be SHALLOWER than
10.1 TECU and the level should not re-dip below ~15 after the first recovery, IF
the carry's re-injection of an older frame realization is what drives the cycle.
If the breathing is unchanged with mu demonstrably non-zero and folds up, the
flywheel is NOT the breathing's driver and the next suspect is the leveling-era
ratchet on the confounded direction (handoff S ROOT CAUSE, still inferred).
- a00 ends in-band and >= arm 13's 20.95; gate 0/0/0; in-band 121/121.
- Grade the LEVEL only on network_vtec_sh_health.csv a00_tecu + a cross-check with
scripts/extcb_gim_verdict.py.  Do NOT grade it on network_ionosphere.csv: that
trace emits x_r alone while the per-LOS iono is SEEDED at allocation, so it is a
correction, not an absolute slant -- and LV-1 deliberately changes that seed, which
moves the broken trace without moving the physics.
- Watch the two sigma0 families in opposite directions (the lane A/B lesson): if the
prior side (prires cb/rxcb) gets quieter while the post-fit DATA side (block-Baarda
G, station congruence) gets louder, that is OVER-RETENTION, not improvement.
